2607.22468.title: Learning to Prepare Molecular Ground States with Transformer Models
2607.22468.paper_summary: Quantum state preparation is a key component of many quantum algorithms. Performing this step efficiently is essential for realizing practical quantum advantage in quantum chemistry applications. Iterative algorithms like ADAPT-VQE can produce shallow ground-state preparation circuits, but become computationally prohibitive for the larger molecules relevant to materials science and pharmaceutical development. Here, we introduce ADAPT-GQE, a generative AI framework that learns to synthesize ground-state preparation circuits for electronic structure calculations. We first use ADAPT-VQE to generate high-quality reference circuits, which are then used as targets for training models for circuit generation. Once trained, the model can efficiently propose and score circuits, enabling reinforcement learning (RL) to drive circuit generation accuracy beyond the accuracy of the ADAPT-VQE training data. This pipeline achieves order-of-magnitude reductions in circuit generation time relative to ADAPT-VQE while maintaining comparable or improved state-preparation accuracy. We demonstrate ADAPT-GQE on imipramine, a well-established tricyclic antidepressant that serves as a representative, challenging target for computational modelling in drug stability protocols. We execute generated circuits on Quantinuum Helios-1, representing a milestone for AI-generated quantum chemistry circuits on state-of-the-art quantum hardware. These results establish a pathway toward automated quantum circuit synthesis for utility-scale quantum computational chemistry.
2607.22468.paper_summary_zh: 量子態準備是許多量子演算法的關鍵組成部分。有效地執行這一步驟對於在量子化學應用中實現實際的量子優勢至關重要。像 ADAPT-VQE 這樣的迭代演算法可以產生淺層基態準備電路，但對於與材料科學和製藥開發相關的較大分子來說，計算成本變得不可承受。在這裡，我們介紹了 ADAPT-GQE，一個生成式 AI 框架，能夠學習合成用於電子結構計算的基態準備電路。我們首先使用 ADAPT-VQE 生成高質量的參考電路，然後將這些電路用作電路生成模型訓練的目標。一旦訓練完成，該模型可以有效地提出和評分電路，使得強化學習 (RL) 能夠推動電路生成的準確性超越 ADAPT-VQE 訓練數據的準確性。這個流程在電路生成時間上相對於 ADAPT-VQE 實現了數量級的減少，同時保持了可比或改進的態準備準確性。我們在伊米帕明上演示了 ADAPT-GQE，這是一種成熟的三環抗抑鬱劑，作為計算建模中藥物穩定性協議的代表性且具挑戰性的目標。我們在 Quantinuum Helios-1 上執行生成的電路，這代表了在最先進的量子硬體上生成的量子化學電路的一個里程碑。這些結果為實用規模的量子計算化學自動化量子電路合成建立了一條途徑。
